products.name: Grain
products.note: Meeting recording AI; highlight clips; CRM integration; consent and sharing

profile_text.body:
Grain is an AI notetaker and conversation intelligence platform that records video calls, Slack huddles, and in-person meetings to produce summaries, insights, and coaching feedback. The company describes itself as built for growing teams, with a focus on small to mid-market and enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams. It captures video, desktop audio, and transcripts, and supports over 130 languages, with the highest accuracy for languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Japanese.

The platform's AI features deliver meeting summaries, account insights, and coaching suggestions, and are designed to pipe meeting data to external tools such as Claude and ChatGPT. Grain states that neither it nor its subprocessors use customer data for model training. A free plan covers unlimited recordings with a 45-minute meeting limit and 90-day history, while paid plans start at $15 per month per user and add advanced AI, conversational intelligence, unlimited meeting length, and unlimited history.

The site's held facts list Grain's core product under the Notes, Knowledge and Meetings category, noting meeting recording AI, highlight clips, CRM integration, and consent and sharing features. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
